A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe the same RECON work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-G support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original symmetry-recovery, OOD-detection and canonicalization experiments on images and molecular conformations in Section 5, with simulations and supplementary analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results, including Figures 5-6, the Appendix C simulations and the Appendix D-F analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2-3.3, Algorithm 1 and Appendix E retain the same class-pose backbone, Fréchet/Tukey-Fréchet normalization, learned parameter and centering predictors, losses and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use MNIST, FashionMNIST and GEOM-QM9 for symmetry recovery, OOD pose detection and test-time canonicalization. The rotation scenarios and Appendix C simulation distributions are retained.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain SGM and IE-AE canonicalizations, the IE-AE OOD baseline, EquiAdapt, and the ESCNN, Partial G-CNN and SEGNN reference classifiers. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 changes the reported GEOM-QM9 molecule-class count from 2,221 to 2,211. Appendix E.2.1 still reports 2,221 in both versions, with unchanged split sizes and selection rules. This is a limited setting-report revision; the PDFs do not establish changed data selection or rerunning.

E4.justification: The multimodal-centroid simulations, neighborhood-size sensitivity, equivalence-class hit-rate and failure analyses, computational analysis, and centered-versus-uncentered OOD ablation in Appendices C-F are unchanged.

E5.justification: Uncertainty summaries, Figure 10's description of runs with different seeds, and the fixed-seed disclosures in Appendices E and F are retained. No uncertainty procedure or run-count information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported experimental and simulation outcomes, runtime measurements and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Figure 6d retains RECON accuracies of 90.96%, 81.96% and 55.92% for MNIST, FashionMNIST and GEOM-QM9, respectively. The molecule-count edit concerns settings rather than an outcome.

T1.justification: The equivalence relation, generative model, centroid definitions, Proposition 3.1, Appendix B proofs and Appendix C derivations are unchanged. The new citation footnote supplies no new mathematical definition, assumption or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and Section 6 retain the same claims about unsupervised instance-specific symmetry discovery, architecture-agnostic orientation normalization, OOD detection and canonicalization of frozen models.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations concerning pose ambiguity, latent-class overlap, centering and optimization, whole-input versus object-level symmetries, and predefined transformation groups remain unchanged in Section 6 and the appendices.

D1.justification: The introduction and Appendix G.2 replace the code repository address aurban0/recon with ZIB-IOL/recon. Implementation, hyperparameter, hardware and timing disclosures are otherwise retained. The PDFs alone do not establish any change in repository contents or functionality.

R1.justification: v5 adds Pelleriti et al. (2025), Approximating latent manifolds in neural networks via vanishing ideals, with a Section 3.1 footnote citing algebraic support for structured per-class latent manifolds. The remaining cited works and substantive research positioning are retained.

P1.justification: Changes include the short supporting footnote, revised funding acknowledgments with additional grant details and VDI/VDE support, and updated version and footnote text. The main narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1b moves the shaded relative-pose sector for digit 5 from the left to the right, and Figure 3 adjusts illustrative latent-space point positions. Added text produces limited page reflow. Experimental figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The supporting citation and small schematic edits provide modest presentational refinements, while the method, proofs and empirical support remain unchanged. v5 also introduces a molecule-count inconsistency: 2,211 in Section 5.1 versus the retained 2,221 in Appendix E.2.1. Together with the code-address and acknowledgment updates, these limited changes leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
